blocks.html: This Privacy Policy explains how Miraudio (the mobile application “Miraudio” / “Miraudio Pro”, package com.palityka.miraudio) processes information when you use the app on Android.
Miraudio is a local music player. It does not require an account, and it does not upload your music library to our servers.
Depending on how you use Miraudio, the following categories of data may be processed:

items: Music on your device — file names, paths or content URIs, duration, and metadata tags (title, artist, album, cover art) read from audio files you choose to scan or open. This data is used to build your local library and is stored on your device.

App settings and library database — theme, language, equalizer presets, selected folders, excluded folders, playback preferences, and similar settings stored locally (for example in a SQLite database and Android shared preferences).
Playback state — current track, queue, and position needed for background playback and media controls.
Purchase status — whether you unlocked Miraudio Pro via Google Play in-app billing. Verification is handled by Google; we store only the resulting Pro/unlock flag on your device.

Advertising data (free version) — if you use the free edition with ads, Appodeal and its mediated ad networks may collect your advertising identifier (GAID), IP address, device and network information, and ad interaction data, as described in their policies (see Third parties below).

blocks.html: We do not knowingly collect your name, email address, or phone number through the app itself unless you contact us by email.
The app may request permissions required for its features:

items: Read audio / media — to scan and play music files you grant access to (MediaStore and, optionally, folder access via the system file picker).
Internet & network state — to load advertisements (free version) and to communicate with Google Play for purchases.
Notifications & foreground service — to show playback controls while music plays in the background.
Wake lock — to keep playback stable during background use.

blocks.html: You can revoke permissions in Android system settings; some features may stop working if you do.

items: Play and organize music on your device
Remember your settings, library, and queue
Show optional ads in the free version
Process in-app purchases through Google Play
Respond to support requests you send us

blocks.html: Miraudio integrates services operated by third parties:

items: Appodeal (free version) — advertising mediation. Appodeal and demand partners may process IP address, advertising identifier, and ad interaction data. See Appodeal Privacy Policy. You can limit ad personalization in your Google/Android ad settings.
Google Play Billing — in-app purchases for Miraudio Pro. Payment and purchase records are processed by Google. See Google Play Terms.

blocks.html: These providers may process data on servers outside your country. Their use of data is governed by their own policies.
Library data and settings remain on your device until you clear app data, uninstall the app, or delete items inside the app. We do not operate a cloud backup of your music library.
If you email us for support, we keep your message only as long as needed to handle the request.
We use reasonable measures to protect data stored by the app on your device. No method of storage or transmission is 100% secure.
Miraudio is not directed at children under 13 (or the minimum age required in your country). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Depending on your location (for example the EU/EEA under GDPR), you may have rights to access, rectify, erase, restrict, or object to processing of personal data, and to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

Because most data stays on your device, you can often exercise these rights by clearing app data or uninstalling the app. For advertising-related data, use Android ad settings and see the Appodeal Privacy Policy. Contact us at pavelpalityka@gmail.com for other requests.
We may update this policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top will change when we do. Continued use of the app after changes means you accept the updated policy.
